version_policy.rule: All files remain at v1.0.0. Do not increment any version string.
version_policy.applies_to: every file touched in this run

comment_policy.module_doc: One short //! block at the top describing what the module/struct does. Nothing more.
comment_policy.inline_comments: Only where logic is genuinely non-obvious. Never restate what the code already says.
comment_policy.doc_examples: If a code example is needed in a doc comment, use  ```rust,no_run  to prevent doc-test compilation of incomplete snippets.
forbidden: Restating struct field names or types in prose comments

operational_settings.consequence: Any struct that holds it must carry a lifetime parameter 'a.
operational_settings.never: Clone or own OperationalSettings inside a compiler phase struct.

tokens_in_general_parser.rule: Owned Vec<Token>. Parser filters, slices, and inserts synthetic tokens.
tokens_in_general_parser.section_parsers_receive: &'tokens [Token] slice from the per-section Vec built during extraction.

symbol_table_in_semantic_analysis.determination: Semantic analyzer reads the symbol table built by an earlier pass; it does NOT own the canonical copy.
symbol_table_in_semantic_analysis.rule: Borrow: &'a SymbolTable for read-only passes. &'a mut SymbolTable only if the pass must write new symbols.
symbol_table_in_semantic_analysis.guidance: Check each SectionAnalyzer independently. If it only looks up symbols, borrow immutably. If it registers new ones, borrow mutably. Never clone the whole table.

ownership_rules.general_principle: If the function or struct does not need to outlive the data, does not mutate ownership, and does not store it past its own lifetime — borrow. Own only when the type must independently manage the data's lifetime.

debug_config_policy.construction: Create DebugConfig::from_debug_mode(operational_settings.debug_mode) once in new() and store it on the struct as debug_config: DebugConfig.

usage.log_gating: Always check debug_config.is_enabled before any format!() call that produces a log string. Never format a string that will be discarded.
usage.test_only_passes: Gate with debug_config.is_testing (which equals cfg!(test) at compile time). Code inside this gate is eliminated entirely in non-test builds.
usage.never: Do not read operational_settings.debug_mode directly after construction. Use the cached debug_config field.

debug_config_policy.allocation_rule: The format!() call itself must be inside the if-guard, not before it.

static_str_variants.description: Keyword, ArithmeticOp, ArithmeticAssignOp, ComparisonOp, LogicalOp, BitwiseOp, DataType, MultiCharSymbol all hold &'static str, not String.
static_str_variants.match_arm_migration: TokenType::Keyword(k) where k is now &'static str. Compare with == not .as_str()==.
static_str_variants.avoid: Do not call .to_string() on these variants inside hot loops. They are already printable via Display.

section_id.description: Token::new last argument is now SectionId, not Option<String>.
section_id.synthetic_tokens: Use SectionId::from_context_str(section_name) when constructing synthetic tokens in the parser.
section_id.never: Do not pass Some(string) or None as the last argument to Token::new.

get_token_value.rule: get_token_value() allocates. Call it only on error/display paths, never in hot-path loops or log gates that may be disabled.

keyword_definitions_changes.phf_maps: All keyword sets are now phf::Map<&'static str, ()> living in the binary's read-only segment.
keyword_definitions_changes.lookup: Use Keywords::is_keyword(word), Keywords::is_data_type_keyword(word), etc. All are case-insensitive O(1) lookups.
keyword_definitions_changes.no_heap_sets: Do not construct HashSet<String> or Vec<&str> from the keyword definitions. The PHF maps are the canonical source.
keyword_definitions_changes.comparison_in_parsers: Match against &'static str directly. Avoid intermediate String allocations for keyword comparisons.

error_manager_usage.acquisition: let error_manager = ErrorManager::get_shared_instance(); — call once in new(), store on struct.

public_api.add_lexical_error: fn(error_type: LexicalErrorType, message: String, line: usize, column: usize, suggestion: Option<String>, source_line: Option<String>)
public_api.add_parse_error: fn(error_type: ParseErrorType, message: String, line: usize, column: usize, suggestion: Option<String>, source_line: Option<String>)
public_api.add_semantic_error: fn(error_type: SemanticErrorType, message: String, line: i32, column: i32, section_name: Option<String>, suggestion: Option<String>)
public_api.add_imports_resolution_error: fn(error_type, message, import_alias, import_path, resolved_path, circular_chain, line, column, suggestion)
public_api.add_ast_enhancement_error: fn(error_type, message, line, column, section_name, suggestion)
public_api.add_value_resolution_error: fn(error_type, message, line, column, section_name, variable_name, function_name, suggestion)
public_api.add_dlm_error: fn(error_type, message, library_path, function_name, suggestion, severity: ErrorSeverity)
public_api.add_binary_serialization_error: fn(error_type, message, file_path, expected_version, actual_version, suggestion)
public_api.add_runtime_error: fn(error_type, message, function_name, line, column, stack_trace: Vec<String>, suggestion)
public_api.add_config_error: fn(error_type, message, section_name, field_name, expected_value, actual_value, line, column, suggestion)
public_api.should_terminate_parsing: fn() -> bool — returns true when strategy is Halt and any error exists
public_api.clear_errors: fn() — reset for new compilation unit
public_api.log_debug: fn(&str) — delegates to MID_Logger, respects debug level

error_manager_usage.severity_determination: ErrorManager internally calls determine_severity(ErrorSource) based on the current error_handling_strategy. Callers do not set severity except for DLM and Runtime errors which have explicit severity parameters.
error_manager_usage.should_terminate_check: Call error_manager.should_terminate_parsing() inside loops after each error to respect the Halt strategy. Do not continue parsing when this returns true.
error_manager_usage.registry_errors: get_registry_errors() returns only ParseErrors of type UnknownStaticObject, UnknownStaticMethod, UnknownInstanceMethod, InvalidMethodSignature, InvalidBuiltinCall.

code_quality_rules.no_unwrap_in_library: Use ? for propagation, .ok_or() to convert Option to Result. unwrap() and expect() only in #[cfg(test)] code.
code_quality_rules.no_panic_in_library: panic!() only in unreachable!() situations that represent compiler bugs, and only with a descriptive message.
code_quality_rules.hot_path_allocations: Never clone, format!, or allocate inside loops that run once per token or per character.
code_quality_rules.pre_allocate: Use Vec::with_capacity(estimate) for collections built in parsing loops.
code_quality_rules.iterators: Keep iterator chains lazy. Do not .collect() unless the result is actually stored or iterated multiple times.
code_quality_rules.string_concatenation: Use write! / format! sparingly. Prefer push_str on a pre-allocated String or use itertools::join.
code_quality_rules.clone_justification: A clone is only acceptable on cold error paths, when storing in multiple independent collections, or when creating a snapshot before modification.
code_quality_rules.professional_naming: snake_case for functions and variables. CamelCase for types. SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE for module-level constants. No abbreviations that obscure intent.
code_quality_rules.no_emoji: Zero emoji characters anywhere in source, comments, string literals, or log messages.
code_quality_rules.arrange_code: Order within a file: module doc, use declarations, constants, type aliases, main struct definition, impl blocks in logical order (new/construction, public API, private helpers), then sub-types. Tests at the bottom behind #[cfg(test)].

concurrent_parsing_constant.note: This is a compile-time constant. Setting it to false costs nothing at runtime and eliminates the rayon code path entirely in that build.

comment_filter_utility.purpose: Reusable token-stream comment stripping. Used by GeneralParser and available to formatters, linters, IDE tooling.

structs_that_need_lifetime: Any SectionAnalyzer that borrows SymbolTable or OperationalSettings
Any SectionEnhancer that borrows the AST or symbol data
lifetime_checklist.rule: If a struct stores a reference, it needs a lifetime. If it only borrows inside a method (function argument), no lifetime on the struct is needed.

final_mandate: Do not alter core parsing logic, AST node definitions, error type semantics, binary serialization format, or DLM pipeline behavior. This run is strictly structural cleanup, ownership correctness, allocation reduction, and comment hygiene. If a change would risk breaking observable behavior, leave the code as-is and note it.
